propositions: Tier-2 must replay Pass-1 finders over a fixed 20-review stratified sample (committed to tier2-sample.json) to compare candidate finding sets to stored findings by norm_id Jaccard and produce a candidate-vs-stored verdict flip matrix.

Single-criterion mode (--criteria <id>) constructs a single-entry criteria tuple and dispatches through ProductionBatchRunner's exec_tier routing (1-TURN/2-STEP vs AGENT, including G3/G4 container split), costing ~$0.25/sample for non-AGENT tiers with real production rates for AGENT-tier criteria.

Stored findings must be filtered to exclude DET-floor criteria (P1-P11 deterministic checks from det_floor.py/det_advisory.py/det_clarity.py/det_lint.py) before Jaccard and verdict-flip comparison, since candidate replay never exercises deterministic findings.

Candidate findings are verified fresh via verify_findings and their verdict computed via pass3_decide/pass3_over_findings, then compared against stored verdict (flip matrix) recorded in the original review's sidecar, not per-question agreement tables.

Fixed sample must be validated against corpus manifest and materialized with code-grounded AGENT criteria (G3/G4/T8) running against pinned verified_at_sha snapshot via source=attested using git worktree for real source access.

Commissioning spend must remain ≤$60 total, every call must use Bedrock frontier model id, and full-mode/baseline runs must be recorded in the ledger with per-criterion usage budgeted from coverage.usage.per_criterion.
